name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for improving DQ-tool
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## Problem / Use Case
*Describe the problem you're trying to solve or the use case you want to address. Why is this feature needed?*

### Example
If applicable, describe a specific scenario where this feature would be valuable.

## Proposed Solution
*Describe how you'd like the feature to work. Be as specific as possible.*

### Example Usage
```bash
# How would users interact with this feature?
python -m dq_tool --new-flag data.csv
```

## Alternatives Considered
*Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.*

## Additional Context
*Add any other context, screenshots, references, or information that might be helpful.*

### Related Features
- Is this related to any existing features?
- Are there similar tools or libraries that implement this?

## Priority
- [ ] 🔴 Critical (blocking users)
- [ ] 🟠 High (important feature)
- [ ] 🟡 Medium (nice to have)
- [ ] 🟢 Low (enhancement)

## Estimated Effort
- [ ] Small (< 1 day)
- [ ] Medium (1-3 days)
- [ ] Large (1-2 weeks)
- [ ] Extra Large (> 2 weeks)

## Checklist
- [ ] I've checked if this feature already exists
- [ ] I've searched for similar feature requests
- [ ] This feature aligns with the project goals
- [ ] I'm willing to contribute this feature if needed
